capture_kind: parent-normalized semantic capture of completed read-only reviewer return

findings.repair: Close the neutral projection schema and manifest, allowlisted views and fields, safe opaque handles, owner review reference, and leakage/injection negative controls.
Bind episode principal, tenant/workspace, vault, Task, capability audience, and scoped delegation at open and reauthorize before existence disclosure on every later command.
Materialize only into an isolated rebuildable episode overlay with closed episode-owned kinds/relations and no canonical graph write.
Prefer host-issued Task/VersionContext handles; if inline capture remains, restrict it to inert server-labeled unverified snapshots with reserved-field rejection.
Evidence resolver must return immutable producer episode/attempt/task/version/criterion/class/scope bindings and reject cross-attempt rebinding.
Use distinct invocation descriptors, credential audiences, schemas, and audit streams; reject mixed generic tokens before target parsing.
Every result declares semantic_effect=none, task_state_unchanged=true, truth_status=not_assessed; completed means episode lifecycle only.
Close close-event fields and overlay outputs; forbid Lesson, Recipe, Recommendation, source, memory, approval, routing, authority, and promotion effects.
Keep L0-L2 host/transport neutral; do not inherit Augmentor route/auth topology without a separate owner-selected integration gate.

defended_boundaries: read and append capabilities are explicitly separate
host context is out of band
raw paths, URLs, secrets, and model-declared execution evidence are rejected
journal acceptance and reducer status are distinct
Lesson verification is a separate future owner route
blockers: projection allowlist and manifest are not closed
episode/evidence ownership bindings are not closed
overlay kind/relation/effect allowlist is not closed
route-level credential audiences are not closed
mutation_statement: Read-only review; no files, Git state, vault bytes, product runtime, or external state changed.
